rationale: SvgPathWidget mapped a viewBox onto its bounds with a single uniform scale, so SVG lowering had to refuse any non-default preserveAspectRatio rather than draw it wrong. An authored element carrying preserveAspectRatio="none" therefore rendered as nothing. This adds an opt-in per-axis stretch to the widget and carries the authored value through lowering, so the element paints as designed. The flag defaults off, so every existing uniform-scale caller is unchanged. This is Pulp-only design-import fidelity work with no named immutable Vellum framework commit to backport.
tests: SvgPathWidget stretch is off by default and round-trips
SvgPathWidget stretches the viewBox onto bounds when asked
